children: Basis offers for soybeans shipped by barge to US Gulf Coast export terminals were flat to mixed on Friday. Basis offers for corn were steady to weaker.
CIF soybean barges loaded in December were bid at 105 cents a bushel over Chicago Board of Trade January futures
, rising 1 cent. Bids for soybean barges loaded in February fell 1 cent, to 105 cents a bushel over March futures
CIF corn barges loaded in December were bid at 94 cents over December corn futures, falling 1 cent.  They were offered at 97 cents, also falling 1 cent.
A surge in the dollar this month hung over the grain markets, making US products less competitive globally.
CBOT December corn > ended down 4-1/2 cents at $4.34-1/2 per bushel.
settled up 13-1/4 cents, or 1.1%, at $12.20-3/4 per bushel.
